refutations.refutedBy: Generate.py --seed 1 on rules v1 (R7 slice 5) + the offline fixpoint that agrees with it
refutations.observed: the row makes the DARK SUIT a prerequisite for itself: L76 is the only way into D7, its every crossing carried the row, and the suit is the only collectible beyond it. AP refused 7 locations, all of them downstream of Level 079 - Darksuit. At source the tile is walkable until eight frames of proximity convert it and a level entry rebuilds it (Tile.as:83-85,390-424) — see IGNEOUS_IS_FREE.
